decisions.reason: Process data archiving and reporting software is central to the firm's move toward data-driven, web-based infrastructure management and costs little to maintain, so the option remains valuable despite no recent observations.

B overlaps with A and only had a website mention, which makes consolidation plausible, but its software maintenance cost is low and there is no clear evidence of failure, so keeping it open is still justified for now.

The manhole door with integrated safety railing is a simple, low-cost hardware extension that meets ongoing safety requirements of municipal operators, so it is cheap to keep and has had no negative signals.

The floating sludge extractor fits the established tank equipment line, and long infrastructure procurement cycles mean its value is still unresolved, so the modest cost of keeping it justifies holding the option.
The flow measurement automation software was launched recently with its own page and is close to the core offer, so its uncertainty has not resolved and keeping it is inexpensive.
